concepts.gloss_en: the setting of the light (imagery of the sun/light sinking in the west, paralleling the departure of the light of the eyes through weeping)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are in the same passage (LM II:67) using the identical image of light setting. 'שקיעת האור במערב' is just the base phrase 'שקיעת האור' with the locative qualifier 'in the west'; the text itself equates them ('so it follows that the west is the setting of the light'). Same word, same concept — the qualifier is not a distinct meaning.
